messages:
Noah: Morning — quick onboarding check-in. Completed laptop image, homebrew + tooling, and synced dotfiles. VS Code + extensions working. Docker runs.

Noah: Blockers: corporate VPN returns 403 when I try to hit the onboarding subnet, so I can't `gsutil` into the redwood-dev buckets or access the internal dataset. Also I don't have `roles/viewer` on project `redwood-dev` so Cloud Console shows empty. PR ping: I left a tiny fix in infra/terraform PR #112 — PTAL when you can.

Mira: Welcome Noah! Nice progress. For the VPN 403 — Sam usually toggles the subnet allowlist. Sam, can you take a look?

Sam: On it. Noah, can you paste the curl output for the auth endpoint? run: ```bash
curl -v https://auth-internal.redwood.example/health
```

Noah: pasted output below:
```
*   Trying 10.1.2.3...
* TCP_NODELAY set
* Connected to auth-internal.redwood.example (10.1.2.3) port 443 (#0)
> GET /health HTTP/1.1\n> Host: auth-internal.redwood.example\n> User-Agent: curl/7.79.1\n\n< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< date: Tue, 12 Mar 2025 14:02:01 GMT
< content-type: application/json
< content-length: 48
\n{"error":"access_denied","reason":"subnet_not_allowed"}
```

Sam: Thanks — that confirms subnet whitelisting. I'll add the new-hire CIDR for Noah's device. Give me a minute and then try again.

Alex: Also pinged infra on your GCP role. Noah, what's your Google account email? I'll add it to the redwood-dev IAM group if you want faster access.

Noah: it's noah.walsh@redwoodhq.com. Thanks Alex.

onboarding-bot: Welcome message: "Hi Noah — your onboarding checklist has been created: /checklist/new/noah. Tasks: access:GCP, access:S3, setup:ci, meet:mentor (Alex)." :tada:

Mira: For the PR, Alex can review if Sam is deep in infra. Alex — can you take a look at #112 later today? Should be quick.

Alex: Yep, I'll do a pass in the next hour.

Sam: Update — added CIDR 10.44.128.0/26 to onboarding-allowlist. Noah, can you retry `gsutil ls gs://redwood-dev-datasets` and share result?

Noah: Retry result: `AccessDeniedException: 403 Access Denied`. Still blocked for buckets, console access seems available now for projects though (I can see redwood-dev).

Mira: Hmm, buckets have a separate bucket policy. Sam, can you check the bucket IAM or whether we need a service perimeter exception?

Sam: Looking now. Quick test: Noah, can you try `gcloud auth login` then `gcloud config set project redwood-dev` and `gsutil ls -p redwood-dev gs://redwood-dev-datasets`? If your user isn't bound to the bucket ACL, that'll show.

Noah: Ran those commands; `gcloud auth login` succeeded and `gcloud config set project` is fine. `gsutil ls -p redwood-dev gs://redwood-dev-datasets` still 403.

Sam: Okay that's IAM-based. Alex — can you add `noah.walsh@redwoodhq.com` to the `redwood-dev-dataset-readers` IAM role? Mira — is that okay with onboarding policy?

Mira: Yes that's standard for first-week data access. Alex, go ahead.

Alex: Done. You should see the permission within a couple minutes. Noah, try listing again in ~2 mins.

Noah: Success — listing worked, saw dataset dirs. Thanks all!

Noah: Today plan: finish the onboarding checklist tasks for CI creds, get through the infra PR feedback, and schedule a 30m sync with Alex for mentorship goals. No other blockers. :smile:
